capabilities: Visualize notes and text blips on a radar with concentric priority rings and category segments
Link blips to vault notes or create standalone text blips and drag notes onto the radar
Configure priority levels (1-8) and category segments (3-8) with per-level, per-category and per-blip colors
Draw lines between blips when a backlink connects their notes, and promote text blips to linked notes
Export the radar as a high-resolution PNG into the vault
disambiguation: Not a charting or data-plotting tool; it is a prioritization board where note positions encode importance and topic.
extras: Radars are saved as self-contained UTF-8 JSON .radar files, portable and editable by scripts or AI workflows; the README documents an optional obsidian-radar AI skill and beta installation via BRAT. Full JSON spec lives in docs/JSON-radar.md rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see at a glance which notes, projects or topics are currently the priority versus on the horizon across multiple areas.
summary: Radar visualization that places notes and text blips on category segments and priority rings to track and prioritize work areas.
